queries.query: large language model OR LLM "network configuration" generation misconfiguration errors failure modes "network operations"
queries.rationale: Directly target empirical reports and analyses of LLMs producing incorrect or unsafe network configurations or commands—core phenomenon to characterize.

queries.query: hallucination OR fabrication "large language model" "operational task" OR "network operations" reasoning errors actionable outputs
queries.rationale: Capture general LLM hallucination and reasoning failure literature as it applies to operational, actionable outputs (not just semantic text).

queries.query: generate-validate-repair OR "verify-and-repair" "LLM" tool-assisted "network configuration" Batfish VeriFlow "network verifier"
queries.rationale: Survey architectures that combine generation with validator/repair loops—promising mitigations for NetOps correctness.

queries.query: network configuration verification "formal verification" "header space analysis" HSA NetPL Batfish VeriFlow "static analysis"
queries.rationale: Locate established deterministic/verifiable network-verification techniques to serve as validators or baselines for LLM outputs.

queries.query: constrained generation "controlled generation" "structured output" "LLM" DSL "network config" syntax-guided decoding
queries.rationale: Find methods for constraining LLM outputs to syntactic/semantic formats (DSLs, schema, type systems) to reduce misconfiguration risk.

queries.query: tool-augmented LLM OR agent frameworks ReAct Toolformer LangChain "tool use" safety "operational"
queries.rationale: Survey agentic frameworks that let LLMs call verification/simulation tools—relevant for orchestrating safe NetOps actions.

queries.query: benchmarks "LLM" networking "AIOps" "NetOps" 6G-Bench TSNBench OpsEval OWL "network configuration" dataset
queries.rationale: Identify existing benchmark suites, their construction, and gaps—necessary to evaluate benchmark validity for operational claims.

queries.query: evaluation metrics "operational correctness" "safety" "rollback" "verification coverage" network config validation metrics
queries.rationale: Gather candidate metrics and measurement methodologies that meaningfully reflect operational safety and reliability.

queries.query: network simulation emulation Mininet NS-3 GNS3 testbed "configuration testing" "validation"
queries.rationale: Find practical execution/test environments to safely evaluate candidate NetOps actions and to serve as validators or oracles.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop NetOps trustability explainability operator oversight "LLM" "automation" "AIOps"
queries.rationale: Survey literature on operator workflows, human oversight, and trust metrics—important for mitigation strategies and realistic deployments.

queries.query: adversarial prompts distribution shift "LLM" safety "operational agents" robustness "NetOps"
queries.rationale: Capture threat models: prompts, input distribution shifts, and adversarial manipulations that cause unsafe NetOps actions.

queries.query: LLM code generation "CLI" "Netconf" YANG "JunOS" "IOS" "device configuration" API generation reliability
queries.rationale: Target literature and tools about LLMs producing device-specific CLI/API commands and the risks/mitigations tied to vendor formats.

queries.query: AIOps "automated operations" "LLM" "autonomous agents" "network management" surveyed approaches
queries.rationale: Map neighbouring AIOps and autonomous operations literature for cross-domain methods, metrics, and prior failure analyses.

queries.query: reproducibility provenance "experiment audit" "preregistration" computational provenance autonomous research notebooks
queries.rationale: Locate best practices for experiment preregistration, provenance capture, and audit trails required by the programme.

queries.query: closest prior work "LLM" "network configuration repair" "configuration synthesis" "dataset"
queries.rationale: Systematically find and verify the most similar/closest prior studies to support novelty/nearest-work comparison.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed papers and workshop papers relevant to LLMs, AIOps, NetOps, network verification, and agentic workflows.
arXiv preprints and technical reports if they provide primary empirical evidence or tool descriptions.
Tool documentation, code repositories, and benchmark dataset releases (GitHub, project sites) when they include methodology and artifacts.
Works addressing operational correctness, safety, verification, validation, or failure analysis for actionable outputs.
Public datasets, benchmarks, simulators, and testbeds relevant to network configuration generation and validation.
Survey papers and systematic literature reviews that synthesize methods across AIOps/NetOps/LLM safety.
exclusion_criteria: Purely marketing materials, blog posts, or high-level opinion pieces without technical methodology or empirical evidence (exclude unless a vendor technical report).
Papers unrelated to operational/ actionable outputs (e.g., purely conversational LLM evaluation without operational relevance).
Non-English works unless an English translation or authoritative summary is available.
Pre-lock internal development artifacts or unpublished internal experiments that cannot be publicly verified.
Works that only benchmark general language understanding with no link to network operations, verification, or actionable command generation.
date_rationale: Prioritise literature from 2020–2026 to capture LLM-era methods and agentic workflows, while including foundational networking and verification works from earlier years (e.g., Header Space Analysis, Batfish) as needed. Update the upper bound to include publications up to the CNSM 2026 submission window when executing the search.
